name: D.J. Demers
bio: D.J. Demers is a Canadian stand-up comedian, best known for his television appearances on season 11 of America's Got Talent and on the late night talk show Conan. Originally from Kitchener, Ontario, Demers was diagnosed with hearing loss in childhood, and focuses his comedy largely but not exclusively on his experiences as a person who wears hearing aids.

credits.title: The Perfect Christmas Date
credits.overview: Marie accidentally swaps diaries with a stranger at speed dating. As Christmas approaches, the holiday magic helps her find the right diary, and the right man, to make her Christmas season truly unforgettable.

credits.title: D.J. Demers: Azoospermia
credits.overview: In his fourth stand-up special, D.J. Demers is more forthcoming and intimate than ever as he shares the fertility journey that led him to discover his hidden disability: Azoospermia.

credits.title: D.J. Demers: Born in '86
credits.overview: D.J. Demers returns with his third one-hour special, where he touches on the struggle of being deaf in a pandemic, the educational power of Scrabble, and his newfound appreciation for sports, particularly the violent ones. credits.title: D.J. Demers: Interpreted
credits.overview: Comedian D.J. Demers shines a light on life in LA, disability porn, big words, not to mention getting haircuts while deaf—all with the help of an American Sign Language interpreter in this one-hour comedy special from Just For Laughs.

credits.title: D.J. Demers: [Indistinct Chatter]
credits.overview: Stand-up comedian D.J. Demers jokes about his life with hearing aids, the impending doom of turning thirty years old, and the perils of performing on cruise ships. Filmed live at Theatre Passe-Muraille in Toronto, Canada.
